caseName: Cargill v. United States ex rel. Pierce
caseNameFull: H. W. Cargill, as Assessor, etc. v. United States ex rel. Frank Pierce

opinions.text: On petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit. Motion to dismiss for want of prosecution submitted November 15, 1920. Decided November 22, 1920. Dismissed for want of prosecution. Mr. U. S. Bratton for petitioners. Mr. George B. Pugh for respondent.
